nodes.text: It’s indeed been a tough time with back-to-back challenges, from viruses like HMPV to natural disasters like the earthquake in Nepal. Your lighthearted take on it reflects resilience and the will to keep going. Stay safe and strong! Let's hope for better and calmer days ahead.
